description: Per-line blame of a postgres file at any commit (code-history index): the commit that wrote each line, as `git blame` (git's default diff). ignore_revs passes through .git-blame-ignore-revs (pgindent) commits that replaced lines one-for-one; reverse adds the commit that later removed each line on that branch. At most 2000 lines a call; commits: author, date, subject per short sha. proposals=true adds per line the earliest posted patch (Message-ID, date) on its commit's threads that added it; proposals_complete=false past 10 commits (those with most lines are read); lines under 4 characters or with no letter or digit get none. Not git_blame (a file's commit history).

commit.description: SHA (7+ hex), branch, tag (REL_17_0), major (17, 9.6), release (17.2), <ref>@YYYY-MM-DD (its last commit that day), <ref>~N or commit URL. Default: the newest release branch

name: blame
